Class VisionSim

java.lang.Object
yall.sim.VisionSim
public class VisionSim extends Object
The simulated world every simulated VisionCamera sees, whatever its vendor. It is PhotonVision's VisionSystemSim: each camera projects the field's AprilTags (and any extra targets) through a simulated lens, with noise and latency.

Cameras join getDefault() unless their config names another world. Update the world once per loop with the robot's true pose: 

public void simulationPeriodic() {
  VisionSim.getDefault().update(drivetrainSim.getPose());
}

    • createCameraSim

      public static org.photonvision.simulation.PhotonCameraSim createCameraSim(String name, VisionCameraConfig config, CameraModel defaultModel, org.photonvision.PhotonCamera camera)
      Makes the PhotonVision simulation of a camera and adds it to the camera's world (the config's, or getDefault()), if the robot program runs in simulation and the config allows it. Camera wrappers call this; robot code doesn't need to.
      Parameters:
      name - Name of the camera.
      config - The camera's config.
      defaultModel - Camera to simulate when the config sets no camera properties.
      camera - PhotonVision camera the simulation publishes to, or null to make a private one named YALL-<name>.
      Returns:
      The simulated camera, or null when not simulating.

    • injectBlackout

      public VisionSim injectBlackout(double currentTimeSeconds, Time duration)
      Injects a deterministic camera blackout lasting duration starting at currentTimeSeconds. Useful for testing vision-loss fallback and recovery in simulation.
      Parameters:
      currentTimeSeconds - Current monotonic simulation timestamp in seconds.
      duration - Blackout duration (must be non-negative).
      Returns:
      This simulated world, for chaining.
